matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Open restricted cover, version control, persons/non-operative charges, source-backed chronology, open evidence/disclosure issue map, applications and actions; orients without sensitive-source detail.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; 300-500 words/narrative page and 10-22 sourced events/table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF from controlled source; searchable text, stable links, repeated headers; not scanned.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unresolved item references and later open-summary revision retained with dated history; no invented defects.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Open-case version excludes sensitive intelligence, closed reasoning, privilege and contact data; client/court/CPS/solicitor variants follow permissions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied statements, generic CPIA prose, repeated chronology, hints that reveal closed material or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Core served case section with signed statements, exhibit/media registers, CCTV/vehicle/phone evidence and person/count issue matrix; provides carrier evidence without deciding identity or guilt.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; statements 250-450 words/page, registers 8-22 rows/page and 1-4 necessary images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed scans, native media referenced externally and born-digital registers; images retain source/time/aspect ratio.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Witness uncertainty, camera offset, corrected exhibit label and later served statement allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Complainant/contact/bystander and irrelevant device data minimised; only served evidence reaches defence/client/court.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated statements, near-identical stills, irrelevant phone records, duplicate registers or decorative exhibits.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: MG6-series non-sensitive schedules, disclosure officer report, prosecutor review/decision record, supplemental schedules and service history; supplies transparent item-level continuity.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 24-34 pages; schedules 10-25 substantive rows/page, reports 250-450 words/page and authentic form whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital searchable schedules with stable row IDs; signed/scanned report where appropriate; no hidden rows/columns.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Supplemental item, corrected description, changed decision and late service are legitimate with consecutive numbering/history; rows never silently deleted.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Non-sensitive schedule may still contain personal data; defence receives authorised schedule, client gets summary, internal deliberation remains restricted.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No boilerplate descriptions, generic form numbers alone, empty rows, repeated schedules or artificial supplemental submissions.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Sensitive schedule and controlled intelligence review: item descriptions, sensitivity basis, provenance chain, senior review, disclosure-test analysis and access log; records sensitivity without automatic withholding.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; controlled schedules 8-18 items/page, review narrative 250-450 words/page and access logs 8-20 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital encrypted/access-controlled records conceptually; no sensitive detail in filenames/bookmarks; scanned source only through controlled reference.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Reclassification, corrected source date and senior-review disagreement retained with audit history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Authorised police/CPS/court/internal-closed only unless ruling permits disclosure/gist; zero defence/client/open leakage before authority.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicated intelligence narrative, speculative source detail, generic secrecy labels, empty sensitive rows or artificial classifications.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Signed/served defence statement, defence issues matrix, informal and formal further-disclosure requests, responses, section 8 application state, third-party request/response/index/viewing log and decisions.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; statements/applications 300-500 words/page, request/viewing tables 8-20 rows/page and authentic form whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital requests/logs and signed scanned defence/third-party responses; received native items indexed, not reproduced wholesale.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Narrowed request, partial/refused response, amended defence statement and updated viewing log allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence strategy beyond served statement privileged; third-party personal/commercial data minimised; client/court receive authorised results only.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated defence narrative, bulk third-party records, generic requests, duplicate logs, blank forms or invented review notes.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: PII procedural suite: application category, notices where required, open application/response, separately controlled closed schedule/submission, hearing record, ruling, redaction/gist/withholding implementation and review history.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-38 pages; applications/submissions 300-550 words/page, rulings 200-450 words/page and implementation tables 6-16 items/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Separate born-digital open and access-controlled closed files; signed/sealed ruling scan where realistic; no closed content embedded in open portfolio.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended application, adjourned hearing, partial ruling, revised gist and continuing-review event legitimate with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Strict role-separated open/closed access; defence/client get only notice/gist/disclosure authorised; closed copy/export/API blocked except authorised scorer/court route.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated sensitive narrative, copied generic legal test, simulated ruling, duplicate redactions or empty closed appendices.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: unauthorised exits contain zero closed content

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: PDF portfolio/embedded-attachment and digital-signature register: parent file, child enumeration, relationship, hashes/types, extraction/review/service state, signature/certificate validation and filing distinction; no auto-execution.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-22 pages; registers 8-22 items/page, signature results 6-14/page and methodology 250-450 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Valid evidential PDF portfolio and attachments retained natively; children enumerated without execution; safe render only for authorised review; signature validation read-only.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Duplicate child name, unsupported preview, expired certificate and superseded signed document allowed with explicit state/history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Each child inherits then refines parent permissions; closed/privileged children remain blocked; client/open views cannot enumerate forbidden names.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No attachment auto-opening, repeated parent/child render, decorative certificate pages, invented trust result or empty attachment rows.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Privilege lifecycle register: item/source owner, privilege basis, waiver state, inadvertent receipt, quarantine, access audit, notification, clawback/return/destruction instruction, disputed status and court determination; zero merits use.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-20 pages; lifecycle logs 8-20 events/page, notices 250-450 words/page and sparse signed acknowledgments permitted.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Access-controlled born-digital register and notices; privileged content never reproduced in register; hashes/neutral descriptors only.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Delayed recognition, mistaken initial classification, disputed privilege and corrected access log legitimate when history retained.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged content only owning defence team; quarantine custodian sees minimum; zero CPS merits, court, co-person or client-inappropriate leakage absent authority.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied privileged text, speculative waiver, repeated notices, fake access events, generic privilege essays or blank logs.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Late-disclosure and procedural control: new-item intake/scheduling/decision/service, defence impact/response, hearing/order, deadline tracker, trial readiness, plus isolated same-name/hash matter negative-control log.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; change/deadline tables 8-20 events/page, applications 250-500 words/page and isolation logs 10-24 checks/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital trackers/logs and court records; stable IDs; isolation log contains neutral hashes/names only, never other-matter facts.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late item, corrected deadline, adjournment and failed-then-passed isolation check retained with incident history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Other-matter facts never accessible; internal isolation results controlled; client/court receive relevant late-service/remedy state only.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicated schedules, generic delay prose, artificial late items, repeated deadline tables or seeded other-matter facts.
